mo_ta_cong_viec: We are seeking an AI-Driven Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience in full-stack application development, strong expertise in Java, Node.js, AWS, and Angular, and hands-on experience leveraging AI-powered development tools and AI-enabled solutions.
yeu_cau:
Key Skills & Qualifications
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
Hands-on experience with AI-driven software development, utilizing tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI assistants to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, refactoring, and documentation.
Experience building AI-enabled applications or integrating LLM/Generative AI services (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, etc.).
Strong proficiency in Java and Node.js for backend application development.
Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, including ECS, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway, AppSync, GraphQL, CloudWatch, and related technologies.
Frontend development experience with Angular (preferred), React, or Vue.js.
Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and microservices architecture.
Experience with modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Git-based version control.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud-native development practices is a plus.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Proficient in using JIRA for sprint planning, issue tracking, and project management.
Experience maintaining technical documentation and project knowledge in Confluence.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.Preferred Qualifications
AWS certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect Associate, or equivalent).
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience implementing AI-assisted SDLC practices to improve team productivity and software quality.
Knowledge of prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), AI agents, or agentic workflows is an advantage.
